name: Ranginui and Papatūānuku separation traditions

earliest_written_attestation.note: Te Ara cites 19th-century dictated accounts, including Hūkiki Te Ahukaramū and Wiremu Maihi Te Rangikāheke.

surviving_manuscript_date.note: The written witnesses used in this seed are 19th-century recorded accounts; this is not an origin date.

tradition_internal_claim.note: Operates in Te Pō/Te Ao Mārama and genealogical sacred time rather than calendar history.

estimated_oral_origin.method: No defensible absolute origin date for specific currently documented Rangi/Papa versions is asserted.

dating.dating_summary: Multiple Māori versions are documented in 19th-century written records; their oral antiquity is not converted into a fake precise date.

notes: Do not universalize one Māori version across all Māori or across Polynesia.
